claims.claim_text: GYU-DET V3 baseline-v1 contains 10,398 supervised images: 8,305 train, 1,040 validation, 1,053 test, with 48,392 annotations.
claims.limitations: These are dataset-foundation counts, not detector-performance metrics.

claims.claim_text: The approved GYU-DET baseline uses six structural-defect classes: Crack, Breakage, Honeycombing, Hole, Exposed Reinforcement, Seepage.
claims.limitations: Raw class IDs remain unchanged.

claims.claim_text: DET-FINAL-v1 achieved mAP50 0.29669431228680787 and mAP50-95 0.17480040543737643 on the one-time held-out GYU-DET test split.
claims.limitations: Label as held-out GYU-DET detection performance, not accuracy or drone accuracy.

claims.claim_text: At validation-selected diagnostic confidence 0.18618618618618618, held-out macro precision was 0.37674095487474335, recall 0.37432339044543, and mean per-class F1 0.3556245448108634.
claims.limitations: Threshold was selected on validation and was not optimized on held-out test. Deployment threshold remains unresolved.

claims.artifact_hash_or_test_result: GPU=NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU; images=1053
claims.claim_text: The held-out DET-FINAL evaluation measured 7.681884140178433 ms inference time per image on the Laptop 1 RTX 4070 environment.
claims.limitations: This is detector-evaluation timing, not whole-drone or end-to-end system FPS.

claims.claim_text: GEN-DAMSEGMENT-ZS-001 completed one frozen zero-shot external evaluation of DET-FINAL-v1 on DamSegment v1 Damage Detection.
claims.limitations: Shared-class evaluation only: Crack and Spalling->Breakage.

claims.claim_text: DamSegment shared-class zero-shot performance was mAP50 0.053176162102447924 and mAP50-95 0.031339626242648855.
claims.limitations: Do not describe as six-class GYU performance or overall accuracy.

claims.claim_text: DET-FINAL-v1 exhibits weak zero-shot external-domain transfer to DamSegment, particularly for Crack recall.
claims.limitations: This scientific limitation must remain visible in presentation material.
